name: Dynamic Appearance Particle Neural Radiance Field
definition: A dynamic radiance field model that captures and models scene dynamics across all time frames using a particle motion network and appearance particles, designed for monocular video data.
summary: DAP-NeRF synthesizes novel views of dynamic scenes from monocular video by applying appearance particles only to moving objects while keeping the background static, unlike ParticleNeRF which requires multi-view data.
